note: Social stability indicators. Crime: FBI UCR (2020+ estimated via NIBRS transition; 2024 murder -14.9% verified, violent crime -4.5%, murder rate ~5.0/100k lowest since 2015; 2025 preliminary: violent crime -9.3%, murder -18.1%). Poverty: Census official (SPM differs; 2021 SPM low due to stimulus; 2024 official 12.6% approx). Incarceration: BJS. Homelessness: HUD AHAR point-in-time (undercounts).

homicide_rate_per_100k.note: 1991 peak 9.8; 2014 trough 4.4; 2020-21 spike ~7.8; 2024 ~5.0 (verified direction); 2025 prelim near 75-year low. Approximate benchmark values.

official_poverty_rate_pct.note: Official measure. SPM 2021 ~7.8% (stimulus/CTC) vs official 11.6%; 2024 official ~12.6% (approx).

child_poverty_spm_pct.unit: % of children in poverty, Supplemental Poverty Measure
child_poverty_spm_pct.note: 2021 CTC expansion cut child poverty to record 5.2%; expiration raised it again (~12-14%). Approximate.

geographic_divergence_note.note: Coastal metros + Sun Belt outperforming; Rust Belt and rural areas lagging since 1980; per-capita GDP gap between top and bottom states roughly doubled since 1980; college-educated metros pulling away.
